prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square be x HSBC airport transfer promotion poster. Use a bright white and pale sky-blue background with a modern airport terminal scene. At the top center, place the be logo and HSBC logo side by side. Add a large red Vietnamese headline reading 'Đặt be đi sân bay thanh toán thẻ HSBC'. Below it place a yellow banner with bold black text 'ưu đãi ngay 150K'. Add the smaller black paragraph 'Áp dụng cho các chuyến có điểm đi - điểm đến tại sân bay Tân Sơn Nhất, Nội Bài, Đà Nẵng, Phú Quốc, Phú Bài, Cam Ranh, Cần Thơ, Cát Bi, Vinh.'. In the center lower area float a black HSBC TravelOne credit card. At bottom left add a cartoon female be rider with yellow helmet and luggage. At bottom right add a bright yellow beCar with a mascot driver waving. Technical style: hybrid photoreal environment and vector mascot campaign poster, bright commercial daylight, crisp polished transport campaign, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
